headline: Pakistan Large-Scale Manufacturing Growth Moderates to 2.07% in Q1
summary: Pakistan's large-scale manufacturing (LSM) expanded by 2.07% in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, moderating below the growth pace recorded in the prior-year period.
why: LSM output constitutes the bulk of Pakistan's industrial production and indicates formal corporate sector economic momentum.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: LSM cumulative expansion slowed to 2.07%, reflecting cooling industrial output momentum.
